hazards.control: Test the stack to the program pressures; bleed and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Accumulator unit (closing unit)
function: The hydraulic power unit with nitrogen-charged bottles that stores enough fluid to close every preventer and open one, operated from the driller's panel and a remote panel.

tabs.overview: Pumps keep the bottles at system pressure; regulators set the annular and ram closing pressures; the remote panel sits away from the well so the stack can be closed from a safe distance.
tabs.engineering: Capacity and precharge per API Std 53; closing times tested.
tabs.safety: Precharge and drawdown tests; panel access kept clear.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
